description: This file defines a generic class StorageDataSetGeneric used for generating test data sets for storage tests in Orleans-based projects. It provides test data for different cases, including grain type, grain ID, and grain state, and implements IEnumerable to iterate over test case indices.

classes.name: StorageDataSetGeneric
classes.description: A generic class for generating test data sets for storage testing, parameterized by grain key and state data types.

methods.name: GetTestData
methods.description: Returns a tuple containing grain type, grain ID, and grain state for a given test case number.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Provides an enumerator over the range of test case indices.
